response.justification: Bogdan is a skilled full-stack software engineer with strong fundamentals and excellent communication abilities, but is fundamentally misaligned with the role's core requirements. He lacks the mandatory 5–10 years of strong hands-on C++ development on Windows (only ~6 months recent C++ experience), has no demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle expertise (MongoDB-focused background), and critically, has zero experience in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domains. His career trajectory over the past decade has been toward web, SaaS, and AI technologies, not financial systems or systems-level C++ development.
strengths: Proven software craftsmanship with strong TDD, CI/CD, and modern development practices across multiple organizations
Demonstrated ability to master diverse technology stacks and communicate complex concepts through workshops and public speaking
Strong foundational programming skills with Java experience and DevOps/infrastructure knowledge
concerns: Critically short on C++ experience—only ~6 months recent hands-on work versus the required 5–10 years of strong expertise
No background in financial services, fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domains; career focused entirely on web, GIS, and SaaS platforms
Limited enterprise SQL experience (SQL Server/Oracle); primary database expertise is MongoDB and web-based systems
